title: Synthetic organic inkblots — exploratory visual descriptions
source: Nine original procedural illustrations from folded-ink-organic-v1, v2 and v3. Generator versions, seeds and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in assets/blots-organic/manifest*.json. These are synthetic illustrations, separate from historical Rorschach plates.
limitations: Exploratory image description only. These synthetic inkblots have no validated psychological scoring and do not constitute a clinical assessment or evidence of model personality. Each image is presented independently.
instruction: Describe the image. Distinguish visible shapes from possible interpretations. There is no single correct interpretation.
